description: Experimental updates a table can switch on to test before they become official (engine/experiments.mjs). Status: v1.7 test package. Each module can be toggled; each card or retune inside a module can be switched off on its own (table option experiments.exclude). Nothing here changes the canonical game unless a table switches it on.

modules.name: Status effects
modules.summary: The thirteen Paperwork statuses (Scorch, Ink Blot, Laminated, Stapled, Red Tape, Denied, Paper Cut, Wet Floor, Barrier, Static Shock, Rush Order, Dog-Eared) and the Reimburse keyword, with the v1.7 guardrails. Denied voids your next card; an Attack may instead be kept by discarding another card.

modules.name: Paperwork cards
modules.summary: 30 new Market cards that apply and cash in the statuses, 4 Combos and 3 Locations.

modules.name: Draw and deck-thin support cards
modules.summary: 12 new cards for draw, cycling, tutoring and deck-thinning decks.

modules.name: v1.7 retunes: draw and deck-thinning
modules.summary: 14 existing draw, cycle and Junk-removal cards get cheaper or gain a Junk rider.

modules.name: v1.7 retunes: Fortress and tank counterplay
modules.summary: 8 defensive cards are toned down and 4 anti-armour cards get cheaper (their Barrier and Static Shock riders need Status effects).
